summary: Bright, spread out white flash in northeastern sky 10:00PM 09/09/2017
description: My family and I were standing in our field looking at the cloudless, 2/3 full moon,  southwestern night sky when all of us said, "Did you see that?!"  We all saw a very bright, white flash in the northeast sky.  What was weird was all of us saw this flash out of the corner of our eyes so that attests to how bright and spread out the flash was.

summary: Low flying Triangle craft with Blue and White lights on each corner near Booneville, Missouri, over Hwy. 70
description: We were traveling East on Hwy 70 around the 100 to 106 Mile Marker.  We were in the passing lane, when the craft came across both lanes (from the North) at a very very low altitude (Just above the tree line).  We all look and our first thought was a Drone, as we own one, but then quickly realized the size was too large for a drone.  It was triangle in shape with three lights, one at each corner that was the color of white and blue.  The craft climbed altitude quickly in a southward direction.  We were able to see the craft for several minutes.  I immediately downloaded a flight tracker app and opened, but no crafts matched the location and path.  I also checked the stats for take offs at the closest airport in Booneville, MO, but on airplanes were reported at that facility for the date and time.

summary: Some friends and I saw a strange blinking light, red, green, blue, and white.  Flying somewhere above northern California.  Moving slowly, very slowly.  Eastword and upward.
description: Twinkling stars??  PD

summary: Bright flash of light in Central Alberta.
description: As we were walking around 10:00 pm, the night of the 9th, we both saw a huge, bright flash of light in the sky, looking in the north direction.  The sky was clear that night (could see a few stars already...  It wasn't a beam; it didn't travel or hover.  Just a quick bright flash of light.  Like something in the sky had taken a picture of us (example just to give an idea of duration and type of light).

summary: 5 bright, silent spheres.
description:
At 9:37 pm my husband and I were sitting in our backyard having a bonfire, when the first of five round, bright "things" flew overhead.  It was low, bright orange, silent, and moving in a straight line at a high speed.  
Then as soon as it reached a certain distance, a second one followed.  Same speed, color, and sound moving in the same direction.  
This continued 3 more times.  All the same.  
We tried to video it, but it is hard to see.  When we are able to slow the video down and zoom in, you can see the sphere changing colors.

summary: Three orange lights in a triangle formation above the horizon in the Poconos.
description:
About thirty minutes ago, just before 9:30 p.m. I spotted three small round orange lights in the sky in upside down triangle formation (Two lights on top, one on bottom) near my home in Newfoundland, PA.  
I was pulling off the main road onto my road and spotted the lights just above the tree line.  I drove downhill to the bottom of the road to follow the lights which were visible on and off through the trees and were moving southeast.  I lost sight of the lights at the dead end of the road.  
Then I drove out onto route 447 north (as going south nothing would be visible due to tree cover) to see if I could spot them again.  I saw two of the three lights barely visible just above the horizon, for about 20 seconds before they disappeared.  There could have been some spotty cloud cover, so perhaps they just disappeared behind clouds, although the stars were visible when I was  back at my house.  
Tobyhanna army depot is south of the area about 10 miles.  I don’t know if this could somehow have been connected with that depot.  
Witness is a ((specialty deleted--medical specialist)).

summary: Standing in the parking lot talking with my co-workers after closing our store for the night. The Sun was almost set but, there was still light in the sky.  Something caught my attention in my…
description:
I turn my head to the left and RIGHT above our store in the strip mall was a bright red light in the shape of a saucer (I personally didn't see the actual craft itself) I said "what the hell is that?" Which made my co-workers turn to look..
In that instant, 3 of the 4 of us seen this bright red light slowly moving from the east to the west above our store.
It then turned slightly to its right and then COMPLETELY disappeared right before our eyes. As if it turned into a portal or went behind a veil.
It LITERALLY disappeared!!  We all started jumping up and down with excitement because we KNOW what we just witnessed together!!  There was no mistaking what it was.
There was no tracer of light, there was no sound whatsoever!!  It wasn't a firework (no sound and this light was too big for that).  It definitely wasn't a drone of any sort because as I said, this bright red light LITERALLY disappeared before our very eyes.

summary: Orangish lights rising in the distance. Began to fade in and out as they went overhead. Then disappeared.
description:
The lights seemed to be rising out of the northeast.  A little left of where the sun rises. Solid orangish lights from far away.  I thought they might be rising flares or low flying large planes.  But there were no sounds or blinking lights.  There were approx 3 separate groups of the same lights with 3-4 in each group.  
As they got closer and overhead, the light would fade out.  Then it would light up 3 to 6 time as it flew overhead.  Sort of like a lightning bug.  But it was above the clouds, which were at least a couple thousand feet.  
When overhead, they were more white than orange. 
They seemed to be moving faster than a jet if it was 35,000 feet.  But only moving as fast as a fast small plane if it was a few hundred feet.  They covered way too much area, too fast and too high to be a drone, unless there are some serious long distance ones out there.  No blinks no sound at all.  
They were rising 3 or 4 at a time.  And I might have seen 8 to 12.  Over a 2-3 minute pe! riod.  The lights were heading south west with no erratic movements, other than fading lights.  There was some sort of fast jet that flew over just prior to me seeing the first lights in the distance.  That…

summary: An identified object in the sky with a bright light hovering right above moon before a major category 3 hurricane (Irma).
description:
On the night of September 9, 2017, around the evening hours of 8-9, I went to take a photo of an eerie moon peaking and hiding behind clouds.  It was a calm breezy evening, basically the calm before the storm.  When I took the photo, it was the night before the great hurricane Irma.  Central Florida (East Orlando) where the photo took place was forecasted to be hit pretty bad by the hurricane on September 10, 2017, in the am hours into Monday morning September 11, 2017.  The photo I took the evening of September 9 showed an eerie moon and a bright light right above the moon in the sky.  When I took a picture of the moon with my cell phone camera I noticed the bright light above the moon. Living North of OIA Orlando International Airport, I see actual planes or helicopters all the time and this image did not look like anything I could identify in normalcy.  As you zoom into the picture the bright light has almost a mushroom shape on top.
Interestingly, the area of Central Florida where I live was supposed to be pummeled by the storm, but fortunately my neighborhood and the adjacent neighborhood had minimal damage.  Some downed trees and general debris from wind.  It almost seemed…

summary: Round UFO seen and then a strange being caught  in a photo around the time of the sighting
description:
I was at a friend’s birthday party in Parker CO on 9/9/17.  To be honest, I’m not exactly sure of the time, but I’m guessing it was between 7:00pm–8:00pm because the sun was starting to set.
Most of the people at the party were in the backyard listening to music and getting ready to eat some BBQ, while a few others were inside watching a college football game.  When the BBQ chef loaded up the platter of meat from the grill, pretty much everyone moved inside to eat as the wind picked up a bit.  But I stayed outside with the birthday girl because I just lit up a smoke.  
Anyway, I was looking up at the sky and telling my friend how much clearer the sky was in Parker as opposed to Denver because of all the light pollution we get living in the city. Just as I said that, I spotted a satellite moving from East to West.  I pointed it out to my buddy and told her something along the lines of, “see, you can see satellites on clear nights like this.”  She agreed and that was that.
About 2 minutes later, I was still sky gazing and I see what I think is another satellite coming from the same direction and heading in the same direction as the first one.  I again pointed it out to her, but just…

summary: Immobile, white dot, not shiny and appeared to be very high in altitude.
description:
I was at the soccer field at California State University/Long Beach, when I noticed a small white dot in the sky not moving at all.  It looked like it was very high up and did not look like anything I have ever seen before in the sky, as it was very still and was not shiny.  
It was next to a crescent shaped cloud (within the crest, south east from where I was), which I found interesting because I found video footage online of the same object I saw, sitting in the crest of a cloud that looked just like the one that I had seen, which also occurred in Long Beach.
I spotted the object while doing sit-ups, and stared at it for about 45 seconds.  I switched positions to do a different exercise and took my eyes off the object for about 5 seconds, when I looked back the object was no where to be seen.  And that's when I started to actually digest what I may had just seen.  
I stopped my workout and scanned the area of sky I originally saw the object, for about 5-10 minutes.  I was baffled that it had just disappeared so quickly after I looked away for a brief moment.

summary: It looked like a plane at first, but I noticed it was simply white with no wings at all.  It also had a slight metallic shine to it.  As my greyhound bus was entering Atlanta, GA, from Tampa, FL,…
description: It did start to look like it was drifting farther away from the greyhound bus, but not because were were on the highway, but because it was drifting directly away from the highway, going Eastward, even though it was pointing North/South.

summary: Tear drop, silent, hover, silver reflective surface.
description:
Laying in hammock watching clear sky and object appeared suddenly.  It was silver, silent, tear drooped in shape and hovered over us for about two minutes, before we finally decided to get out of the hammock to investigate.  
We are 100% certain it was not a plane because a plane actually flew under it while we watched hover.  Ha!  That provided size perspective relative to the Boeing 737.  It seemed to be about a quarter of the size of the plane.  We could also hear the planes engines but this craft was silent.  Its movements we odd.  It seemed to be able to move side to side a little.  It even seemed to shoot up at one point.  Then it finally took off at a high rate of speed.  It was so strange.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Seen a light go across the sky higher than a plane would be in a faster pace, and seen two more about 15 min later heard no sound
Circle object, Sheffield, MA, shifted gradually, but in what looked like controlled and precise movements.  Dog barked.
description: The crystal (looking) circle object was seen while walking our dog because he barked.  The object was about the size of a VW Bug.  The thing was over a cornfield near Boardman and Covered Bridge Ln.  It shifted gradually but in what looked like controlled and precise movements.  This was at a height veering from 80–20 feet before rising and virtually dissolving into the sky.

summary: I initally saw one very bright light that looked like a very bright satellite.  My girlfriend then said," look, there's a 2nd one.
description:
I initally saw one very bright light that looked like a very bright satellite.  My girlfriend then said," look, there's a 2nd one flying with it.  And then we saw a 3rd light.
The three lights were flying in,a large triangle formation in a Northern direction.
The sorthernmost light was much brighter than the other two, bit then quickly the front light became the brightest.
After about 30 seconds the lead light shot across the sky.  It looked just like a dim shooting star. The other two lights quickly faded away.
I have no explation as to what earthly objects or craft/crafts would be capable of what we witnessed.

summary: It's a clear cool night.
description:
I was letting the dog out in front of house and looked at the stars.
I noticed a bright white light originated from the northwest moving quickly to the northeast.
It moved at a constant urgent speed it began brighter than a bright star, and as it traveled, it went bright to dim and smaller until not visible.
Like a passing ball would seem bigger as it got closer and then smaller as it got further away.
It made no sounds and no trails.

summary: Blueish orb which flew away to the North into clouds.
description: MY VEIWING REPORT:  On Friday evening 9/8/17, at approximately 9:45 PM, I was looking at what I thought was a beautiful blueish moon, when with an unbelievable speed the moon (or orb as it seemed to turn out to be) flew from south to north into the clouds as witnessed by my adult daughter also.

summary: Two pair of orange star like objects observed at equal distance moving about.
description: I saw two pair of orange lights at the same distance from each other over the city of Syracuse meandering over the clouds before they were not seen anymore.

summary: I spotted 3 bright orange circular objects floating together hovering over a field.  The object didn't have any sound, and were moving slowly in formation, in a gliding side to side motion.
Metallic object fell from sky in front of me while I was driving north a few miles south of Albuquerque Airport.
description:
First, let me say that this was not a UFO in the sense of something alien, but it was definitely something falling from the sky (Unidentified Falling Object) on September 8, 2017, at 1825.
I was driving north on I-25 a few miles south of the Sunport exit.  All of a sudden, this object fell out of the sky in front of me to my left.  It came diagonally across the highway at fairly close range.  I was driving past a collection of large white oil storage (?) facilities that were on the left.  The object seemed to fall between the highway and those tanks.
It was hard to judge size but perhaps two fists in size might be a good guess.  It appeared to be shiny metallic but was not on fire or glowing in any way.  Made me wonder if a piece had fallen off a jet flying in that area.  If I had time, I might want to drive back there and look on the ground to see what I might find.

summary: 15 white dots visible for minutes, changing formations. Moving in multiple directions at steady speeds and even movement.  No lights
description:
I witnessed and have numerous pictures of white dots that moved like satellites, but in multiple directions, but even and steady like satellites.  Not balloons, not birds.  White dots.  Very very high up.  May have been triangular in zooms.  12 then 3.  Pictures show changing formations of dots.  
They started to move west and disappeared.  They are currently on my instagram "lanadelmama" in two posts that are blue skies (to identify which posts.)

summary: SHINY WHITE OBJECT IN THE SKY, VERY VISIBLE TO NAKED EYE.
description:
APPROXIMATELY 10A.M., WHILE WORKING, NOTICED A WHITE ROUND FIGURE IN THE SKY.  CO-WORKERS WITNESSED THIS AS WELL.  SHAPE DID NOT MOVE FOR SEVERAL HOURS.  
AT ONE POINT, WHILE LOOKING AT THE SHAPE, IT DISAPPEARED.  THE OBJECT WAS GONE FOR A TIME LONG ENOUGH TO CALL THE REPORTING CENTER.  WHILE ON THE PHONE, THE OBJECT RE-APPEARED.  NOT SURE IF IT WAS THE ANGLE THE SUN WAS HITTING THE OBJECT OR IF IT MOVED MOMENTARILY. 
 CALLED FRIENDS AND COWORKERS AT DIFFERENT LOCATIONS TO CONFIRM WHETHER OR NOT THEY WERE ABLE TO SEE IT.  THEY COULD SEE AND DESCRIBE THE OBJECT AS I SAW IT.  
BY APPROXIMATELY 3:30, THE OBJECT WAS GONE. 
THE OBJECT WAS EASILY SEEN FROM THESE THREE COORDINATES:  
1)  LAT-41 56'16.31"N LON-96 27'42098"W  
2)  LAT-41 43'52.06"N LON-96 30'5.32"W  
3)  LAT-41 47'2.32"N LON-96 13'12.51"W
We spoke with the witness via telephone on two occasions, and he seemed to us to be exceptionally serious-minded, and unusually capable as an objective witness.  PD

summary: Bright white sphere high in the morning sky, illuminating light grows in size, then vanishes in an instant.
description:
I was traveling to work along Beltway 8 East in Houston, TX, this morning, Friday, 9/8/17, at 8:45am, and noticed an extremely bright light high in the clear blue sky.  The illuminating light was spherical and grew in size, somewhat changing shape, then decreased in size, then completely disappeared in an instance.  It did this three times within a period of 3 minutes or less. 
It definitely was not an airplane; there was never any definite shape that formed, no white trail of smoke, no clouds around it, no sound (though it was very high in the sky). 
I called my husband immediately to share what I had seen, as I was perplexed as to what it could be and very excited, it sounded like other UFO sightings I’ve heard described.  
I’m trying to find out if there are other local reports of people witnessing the same thing.

summary: Was driving to work on I-5 north this morning.  Some mornings you can see hot air bolloans out, I noticed one in the sky and suddenly I noticed to the left of the hot air balloon.  There were three…
description: Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

location: Vadnais Heights/White Bear Township, MN, USA
summary: Saw 2 bright white lights, 1 red light, and 1 green light hovering above 35E North of HWY 96, Next to Polar Lakes Park.
description:
Aircraft hovered over roadway as we approached, we overtook it at 60 MPH.  After we passed it it strafed left and right a few times then headed West.
It appears to be drone, however, as I drone pilot, I did not recognize the shape or lights at all. It did not strobe in the way that a normal drone or manned aircraft would.
Everyone in the vehicle saw it as well.
Light pattern was Whites on the outside, with red and Green in the middle.  Like this -> W R G W  Aircraft appeared to be about 1 meter in width and flying at an altitude of 100'  A drone in that size category is many thousands of dollars (and difficult to fly) which would place it in the professional category, since no events or construction are going on in the area, it would be unusual for an aircraft such as that to be in there area and flying at night and over a road (both of which require extensive permits from the FAA).

summary: It was round blinking lights all colors red pink green all colors Slightly moving over time along with several others of the same
description: Source elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  Probably a hoax.  PD

summary: Strange colored lights blinking and moving erratically in south Denver sky.
description:
I first noticed 2 distinctive lights.  one red and one green.  The red light was in the upper left and the green light was to the bottom right.  
The lights were solid, then they began to blink.  Both started blinking in a pattern that was frequent in wavelength like that of a plane, but then they started blinking independently instead of at the same time.  Then the green light went out and the red light started moving up and down erratically and very precisely.  
Then the green light came back on and blinked very erratically and the red went off.  It then flew overhead at incredible speed from the north sky to the south sky and descended out of view.  When it flew overhead, it was pure silence.  
My friend who also saw it accounts that he saw blue and white lights too.  He was certain he saw them, but I am certain I did not.  We both watched very intently.  No craft was actually seen, only two lights.

summary: Looked up two different nights.
description:
Same sphere turned white, navy blue, black then invisible.
Size no bigger than a small medical tablet  A sphere with big rivots and a central band.
Formed a triangle under Canis major, then next night was down and left of dipper.
Could be a satellite, but the coloration of light reflected would not coinside with the colors that were represented.
Witness indicates that the date above is approximate.  PD

description: On two occasions, we attempted to telephone the source of this report, and she hung up, both times.  Probably a hoax.  PD

summary: Black triangle over Texas.
description:
My wife and I had our neighbors over for dinner.  It was about 9:30 or 10:00.  When my neighbor saw this thing just appear.  
It was a black triangle the moon was coming up so you could see the outline on the sky.  It had a grid of lights across the bottom, larger ones on the edges.  They were flashing and changing all colors. It moved north to south over the top of the houses in my back yard.  Much bigger than an airplane.  
It moved steadily and silently across the sky at a good rate of speed.  We watched it just slowly fad out and disappear at a steady speed.  
Their was three of us that witnessed it and it lasted about 15 seconds.

summary: Glowing Egg Shaped UFO with Flashing Lights
description:
UFO sighted 9/7/2017 over west end Billings, MT, at 10:00 P.M., until 11:00 P.M..  
UFO was egg shaped, glowing grey-blue, with flashing lights (red, blue, green).  UFO had ring of small white lights around circumference in 3 bands.  
UFO hovered in place for close to 30 minutes, then slowly moved west and north out of site.  
UFO was observed with naked eye, but required spotting scope to see details mentioned above.  
Skies were clear with a little smoke caused by fires in Montana.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Driving down Henderson RD towards High St with my boyfriend, we saw what appeared to be 2 connected oval/disk like crafts that had bright glow.  Upon inspection, did not appear to be a drone or blimp.
description:
I honestly have never seen anything like it before and was shocked, as it was a busy evening and there were many people out and about.  
We watched and observed for as long as we could, whilst driving, and when our view was blocked by trees for a few minutes, we could not longer see the UFO.

summary: We were out at our island north of Parry Sound out of Snug Harbour.  The island is in open water and there is a lighthouse five mile out from us called Red Rock which is very large barrel-shaped.
description:
At this we were out on the open water side looking out at the channel marker blinking and what was left of the light below horizon when we heard the red rock fog horn which couldn't be sounding because it was taken out in the mid 1970s.  My Dad worked for the Coast guard the took it out and I saw it on the Base in Pary Sound.  I knew that sound and had heard it all the time as a youth being out at the island.  Each lighthouse has a distinctive sound.  
Well off to the left of the lighthouse, there was a reddish glow which appeared to be right on the water, but it was a distance out.  It moved slowly away from the lighthouse area traveling due south.  My Son and Daughter and I were captivated by it.  The light seemed to go under water but not sure because the light got bigger.  It then just moved away at a fast speed and was gone out of site within seconds.  I have no idea if the light and the foghorn had anything to do with each other.  Could not make out a shape causing the light.I asked people in Snug Harbour if anyone had heard anything, but no one did.  There is a store there were islanders come to get supplies and also a restaurant there called Gillies.  My daughter, 23, was…

summary: Multiple round orange lights traveling horizontally, East to West, at low altitude.
description:
I saw a few strange orange lights outside my window.  I live near Orlando International Airport so several planes fly overhead every hour, these lights did not look at all like planes or helicopters.  A plane will have a red light on the left wingtip, a green light on the right wingtip, and a strobe light in the center.  
This was a solid orange light, there were several of them traveling from East to West, and they appeared to be at relatively low altitude.  There were also planes in the sky at the time and these lights were drastically different, they sort of looked like flares but were traveling completely horizontally.  
When one passed particularly close I thought it sounded like a rocket engine but it could have been the sound of a jet passing overhead.  
A buddy of mine saw them outside his house about 15 minutes later; he lives nearby and also saw the orange lights traveling horizontally East to West.    
Video: https://youtu.be/n251RhdLho8

summary: 2 circle lights moving in unison, equal distance apart.  Plane flew in front of them
description: 2 Lights hovering moving in unison.  They became still.  Flickered than disappeared  Plane flew in front of them.

summary: One went SE--->NW, tracking slow and steady, no up/down or sideways.  Absolutely no sound detected, and there was no significant ambient noise to mask possible jet or motor noise.  Difficult to gauge…
description:
Not military.  Not drone.  Not a bird.  Not a helium filled balloon, because likely that would have gained altitude.  The flattening part was weird, like a plate was on edge vertically, spinning around on the vertical axis occasionally.
If that wasn't enough, the thing's twin followed, maybe a few miles behind, following the same path; same slow speed, altitude, direction, silence and occasional spin.
My friend witnessed this as well.

summary: Saw 1 star shoot into 3 flying objects then disappear
description: A group of us were outside smoking cigarettes when we looked east & saw what looked like a bright star up over the capital area the all of a sudden 2 more star objects shot out of it really fast in different directions then would stop and freeze looking like stars in the sky then they would move all over the sky really fast in all directions that aren't normal and when they moved there was like a little flame looking aspect behind it but when it stopped the flame would disappear and they would just look like bright stars in the sky. It was really weird & they would stop and go like that all over the sky. Then as we all stood there all watching stund 1 by 1 they just disappeared. It was the absolute most crazy thing I've ever seen.

summary: North of Nashua approximately one mile, two glowing balls. Motionless when first observed - perhaps at an altitude of 2000 feet, then both shot staight up at break neck speed, somewhat at an arc, as…

summary: S-Shaped Black Tumbling Rotating UFO.
description:
Middle of the day.  Walked outside, looked up and there it was.  It was floating through the air, a dark S-shaped object, maybe teen feet or so in size - maybe a half mile or less in the sky.  These are guesses to size and distance.
It tumbled through the sky, and also, the ends of the S would contract at times, then go back to an S shape - and also I did notice that it would also rotate horizontally, and when it did - it seemed as if it was 2-dimensional on that plane, otherwise tubular. At one time during the horizontal, I noticed a kind of yellow semi-transparent square projection shape go over it, in a flash of time. It strangely enough seemed to go directly over my field of view. I thought about it later, that I was feeling the wind from the opposite direction. As I had plenty of time, time of encounter 30+ seconds, I could not see or identify what it is, even observing it intently, and it did not appear to be a balloon of any kind.  There are no balloons sold in any local stores that match this.
I then went on the internet to look for "s-shaped ufo's" and I found some others that have had similar sightings:  
http://www.nuforc.org/webreports/135/S135145.html…

summary: Disk Shaped Golden light moving different directions in the sky
description:
Time Seen: 8:01 PM  End time: 8:03 PM (Approximate time) Facing North-East 
Location: Aurora, CO  
I was cleaning my new car up, and it was starting to get dark, so I went ahead and started to clean the windows.  After throwing some garbage away in a bag, I placed on the sidewalk next to my vehicle, I looked up at the sky randomly for some odd reason facing North East.  I watched three airplanes fly ahead.  But there was a fourth one…  The fourth one was glowing a golden hue and had a smaller orb of golden light flashing on the upper left side.  This smaller orb of light looked to be detached from the object but followed it in sync.  It was glowing and the golden lights were together in a curved disk shape at the bottom of the object.  It was moving to the right quite slowly, then it stopped dead in its tracks.  I sat there trying to calculate what I was seeing.  Something was off about it.  The other planes passing by had white and red flashing lights flying one direction, but this one stopped above the neighborhood above the tree line, lower in the level of the airplanes flying! past in the sky.
I then said aloud, "Alright, I see you B--- and I'm not afraid.  If you are…

summary: Object was low, 100-200 feet, moving straight line west to east 20-30 mph, black, non-transparent, shapeless, billowing, silent, showed occasional white light and occasional red light, no green to…
Multiple circular orb shaped, large, yellowish and bright.  Seemed to come from the ground level straight up - disappearing when reaching a quarter into the sky.   Around 15 or so lights in a dot…
description: Once a few disappeared more appeared from the ground level.  Deadly silent, no clouds, bright starry night, no light trail, smell or sound.  Lasted around 5 minutes.

summary: Red light, moving very fast.
description:
I saw a red light in the air traveling pretty close to the ground.  There were no flashing lights to signal it was an airplane.  It was moving way faster than anything I've seen before.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Large red Mars-like planet in the sky then disappeared
description:
Looking E,SE into the Seattle sky from Magnolia where I reside, I noticed a large red ball which resembled a planet.  I took a photo of it because it seemed odd and out of place as I had never seen this before.  This was red in color like Mars, but is was not where Mars would have been in the night sky on September 6th, and it did not move.  
After I took the photo, around 3.5 – 4 minutes later, I returned and it was gone.
Source of report fails to indicate the date of the event, and provides no contact information.  PD

summary: 3 miles east of lax I stepped outside at night, looked up to see a shrinking flaming orb moving slowly until it disappeared in front of a star.
A 20 degree wide deep blue shaft of light from the horizon to the zenith just after sunset lasting 20 minutes
description:
Just after sunset, on the leeward coast, I observed a 20 degree wide shaft of deep blue light from approximately where the sun set to the zenith.  I thought at first it was a military laser effect which I am familiar with, but it was too wide a beam and I believe it must be related to the aurora like phenomenon.  It was not a cloud.  It was deep blue and distinct. It disappeared after about 20 minutes.  It was probably a plasma like effect in the atmosphere.  It was unusual.
Probably not an aurora, given the time of the sighting.  Possible shaft of sunlight??  PD

summary: Possible landing zone.
Large silver orb shaped ufo seen in Warsaw Illinois.
description:
I was in my garage, when all of a sudden, there was a giant sonic boom it knocked a few things off the wall it was so big.

summary: Large ball of light descends over empty lot.
description:
Having finished my shift, I was driving east on Otay Mesa Road, when a luminous ball of white light caught my attention.  Given the fact that there are two airports nearby,  Brown Field, which was just behind me to the west, and Tijuana International Airport, two miles south of my location and over the border, I figured it was a commercial aircraft preparing to land.
But when my passenger, a co-worker, mentioned that the light wasn’t going to make either field, I decided to pull over, close to the right side of the curb.  Before I could come to a stop, however, the headlights failed and the engine died.  It was just about 12:45 AM when the light glided over SR 125, which was approximately one-eight mile in front of us.
As the ball of light approached the vacant field to our right, I became aware of the distinct feeling of pins and needles about my face and in my hands, especially around my mouth and in my fingertips.  That’s when I reached for my phone, only it was dead.  My coworker reached for the pair of sunglasses that he kept in the glove box.
I would say the ball was twenty-five feet in diameter, but I couldn’t make out a distinct edge.  At first it remained motionless,…

The light would have been over Indian Trail or maybe further west/south.

summary: Flashing lights from a craft in an irregular patten, sometimes retracting to other areas, in Alexandria, VA
description:
I was just laying in bed on my phone, when I was alerted by bright flashing lights in the sky.  I have lived in the DC area for a long time, and know the behavior and appearances of planes and other craft in the area.  I have also lived in military towns and this event was shocking to me. 
Facing southwest from my apartment window, I saw flashes from an unknown craft in the sky of white-yellow light.  The light blinked quickly and unlike crafts on earth the flashes seemed to have no regular pattern.  At times the flashes would refract momentarily to a distance away (perhaps a mile or so- it's hard to know how far away this craft(s) was) and then blink back to the origin area.  
This went on for about 5 minutes and then suddenly the light stopped flashing.  I have never witnessed a UFO in my life and found this event shocking in its irregularity.

While coming back to my house, I stopped to admire the moon (it’s ALMOST full.)  As I was standing there, something to the bottom right of the moon zoomed a bit, left a small white-ish trail, pulsed/zoomed again and left a looooong, thin fire trail and was GONE.   The thin fire trail only lasted for a few seconds.  It was a muggy, cloudy night out there tonight.  No stars are visible, so I can’t believe it was a shooting star….

summary: Silent black triangle aircraft without lights seen traveling through the sky at night.
description:
My wife and I observed a single black triangular aircraft, with no lights and absolutely no sound traveling in a straight line from the NE to the SW.
We were outside talking and relaxing in the back yard, admiring the stars and the full moon. There was not a cloud in the sky.
At first, when I saw the aircraft, I assumed it was a very large turkey vulture gliding in the sky.  Then I realized it was night time, and how quickly the aircraft was traveling in a straight line.
We were able to watch the triangular aircraft travel through about half the sky.  I noticed the aircraft from the tree clearing behind us to the North/Northeast to over the roof of the house about 30 feet away towards the Southwest.  We can't say if the object was 200 feet above us or 10,000 feet.  We waited and expected to hear exhaust within a several seconds of it passing but we were surprised that we heard nothing.  I can estimate that the aircraft's angular diameter at about about 3 degrees.
I am an amateur astrophotographer in my spare time, and I have never seen such an object like this before.  I always have an explanation for what is in the sky, but this was very different.  My wife takes very little…

summary: Bright Orb dimmed , sped up and changed direction
description:
I was walking out of family dinner with my wife, and in this particular town outside the Albany, there is very little light pollution.  You are able to see much more of the night sky very clearly, so I always get lost looking when I'm out that way.
As I walked outside and looked up, a flash caught my eye that seemed close, like a BRIGHT orb.  Just as fast as it flashed, it dimmed out and just looked like another star in the sky, except this started moving north at a very fast pace; faster than you see normal aircraft move.  And it was very high, I'd say 50-60,000 feet up.   
Then as I followed it, it stopped, reversed direction very quickly the way it had come, and disappeared.  This isn't the first time I've seen strange craft out that way, but this was the one I could best explain.  
I'm hoping someone else saw this on that Monday night as well.  It's puzzled me because I have a pretty extensive knowledge of aircraft--and this thing did not move like any aircraft we have developed here

summary: Two bright bluish-white Orbs spotted over Broomfield, Colorado on the night of September 3rd, 2017, heading south.
description:
My son (aged 32), wife (aged 59) and I (aged 60) were sitting on my son’s back porch, smoking cigars and talking when I noticed a bluish white orb moving from north to south. It appeared to be moving at 150 mph and at an altitude of 5,000 feet above ground.  This was estimated by judging against planes lining up for landing at DIA.  It did not emit a sound and had no flashing lights.  The orb moved at a steady speed and heading. We followed it with binoculars until it was lost behind trees and houses.  It was tracked for about 15 minutes.  After about five minutes of discussing what we might have just seen, another orb on a similar size, shape, heading and speed was spotted. We were able to get some pictures and video of the second orb.  We could not discern any structure to the shape but we are reasonably sure it was not a hot air balloon due to the duration of the flight and perceived size of the object.  Plus we checked wind directions at various altitudes and! all were in different directions from the orbs flight path.  The sky was clear.  
I am a former Air Force Nuclear Officer and very familiar with aircraft and flight characteristics.  This sighting did not fit the normal…

summary: One golden orb.
description:
On, or around, September of 2017, while watching TV (8 or 9pm), I felt a strange pull/need to look to my left out my window, where I saw a golden orb hovering about 6-8 feet out from my fifth floor apartment window ledge.  I got up and went to the window where it continued to hover for 30-45 additional seconds.
The orb, which was slightly larger than a full moon, glowed with a golden light.  While it hovered there I thought, "What is this, a drone?"  I tried to see an outline within the glowing orb, but couldn't detect any image whatsoever.
It hovered for at least thirty seconds then slowly moved from east to west then northwest.  As it moved away it seemed to be on a level altitude.  I watched until it was blocked by a neighboring building from view.  A helicopter followed the orb a minute later, following between the two buildings!  As I live close to three airports, and live in a densely populated city, I see airplanes, large and small, and helicopters (traffic and others) regularly.  All follow the same flight paths.  I have never seen any orb, much less an aircraft (i.e. helicopter), travel between two buildings.

summary: Odd shaped object that rotated and got brighter and darker while moving across the sky.
description:
I was in the lying in the backyard watching the stars come out.  About 20 minutes into it, I saw an object in the corner of my eye, and then put my full focus on it.  My wife was in the garage and I called out for her to come see it.  She only saw it for the last 10 seconds, or so.
It made no noise and moved rather quickly.  It was gray in color but occasionally would light up and get brighter.  I'm not sure if this was reflected sunlight or what.  The shape was roughly cuboid or spherical and seemed to have bumps and parts that stuck out.  The object appeared to be rotating.
I don't really know how far away it was other than the fact that it went behind a large tree that was about 30 feet away.  The apparent size was similar to my pinky nail with my arm outstretched.
The path of the object was roughly NW to SE parallel to the Willamette River.  After it passed behind the large tree, we watched it get smaller and disappear towards the part of the sky where the moon was.

At the same time this was happening, the sun had a faint halo around it.  When they stopped appearing, the halo was gone, and it started getting cloudy.  
We are almost directly under the flight path of DTW, so you can obviously tell what was an airliner and what was a sphere.  
The spheres did not leave any kind of trail, and would sometimes zig-zag their flight paths.

summary: MONROE - HUNDREDS OF FLYING OBJECTS.
description:
While walking along Halsey Reed Rd, I witnessed one flying object that didn't look like a plane.  As I continued with my walk, multiple lights appeared all throughout the sky.  They were various sizes, shapes and colors and depending on the vehicle their lights blinked differently.  The blinking lights were mostly clear; however, some were red and green, also.  Some were slow flying and hovering, while others were fastly approaching at a greater speed.  Some were just balls of light, while others were more shaped like aircrafts, similar to UFOs - mostly resembling cylinders, diamond-like kite figures and balls of light.  There were hundreds - some in the distant sky resembled twinkling lights, but they weren't.  After an hour period passed, multiple low flying airplanes began to show up, as well.  Even as I write this I can hear different flying objects in the sky.
Possible hoax.  We suspect a nighttime sighting, and have amended the time above.  Anonymous report.  PD

It did not seem to be moving at first but then I noticed it was moving and coming in my direction (eastward).  It had 2 rows of semi-large bright lights in the center, 8 of them I believe (these were the ones that made me think it was a bright star at first).  It had smaller red lights on the corners and a row of similar size white lights along the back edge.  The smaller lights were blinking randomly.
The object appeared to be about the size of a commercial airplane and moving at a similar speed, but had no wings and there was no sound at all.

They were arranged in a formation that was similar to the stars in Orion's belt.  They were about 60 degrees above the horizon.  I pulled over to watch and after about 10 seconds, they just faded out.  After about 5 seconds, they faded back into view in the same locations.  They did not appear to be moving. I sat in my truck for another 5 minutes or so and did not see them again.

summary: About the size of a satellite traveling unfixed L-shape path w/inconsistent flashing appearing/disappearing inconsistently
description:
The sky was perfectly clear, black and the stars and Milky Way were spectacular.  Over the western horizon, my husband and I saw a quick flash of light, about the same size as a star or satellite.  
About 15 seconds later we saw the same flash again, this time it was slightly above where we saw the first flash.  
We both stared at the sky and waited.  The flash continued at inconsistent intervals (10 – 30 seconds) and seemed to be traveling in a straight path going upwards (west horizon to east).  
When looking closely, the flash consistently mimicked one of a light house – not simply on/off, but appeared to be a light circling around and did not create a distinctly visible beam or tail.  
After a few minutes, the flash seemed to begin moving in a different direction, toward the south.  The flash continued for another minute or two then faded away toward the southern sky.

summary: Round hovering ball of light (craft) no noise, disappears after 3 minutes
description:
Around 9:30pm, I was leaving work with a coworker and standing outside, facing toward south west, not extremely high was a round craft which looked as it was lit from within a white/blueish color with a fog/haze around it,  There was an airplane which was flying much higher and it was obvious it was a plane, we heard it and all.  
This was different.  It didn't appear to be flying but hovering over the area, we saw it for about 3 full minutes and then it disappeared right infringement of our eyes.  
There was no sound or anything, it was also not a drone (our immediate thought at first) it was a large white round craft.

summary: Definite UFO just seen.
description:
I live out here in the mountains (2000 feet up) , so it's perfect for night viewing and there's always interesting stuff out here it seems.   I've seen meteors burn up several times.. but this was no meteor.
It was a lighted object , just as faint as some of the stars out there.  But it was moving.   I couldn't believe my eyes at first, because it literally looked THAT far away, like it was one of the stars that are hundreds of light years away, But was moving from due south to due north.  and then out of view.  
I got my cell-phone but the light from it was faint, and wouldn't even come into view on there.  It was definitely not a meteor or asteroid because it moved in a straight line from south to north and never was there any fainting of the the solid light.  It was of the same solid color  (white or yellow) the whole time.  No blinking or blinking lights of any kind either.   Planes fly through here all the time, and this was no plane from this planet.    It honestly just looked like an orb of light moving from south to north....but it was VERY far away it seemed.  The light on the object may of been from the sun setting as well, as the sun set like an hour (or more) ago , but…

summary: An unidentified object that was not discovered until the photo was downloaded into my computer.
description:
I am not sure of an exact time as I didn't even know I had photographed this object, until I uploaded pictures from my camera.  I was taking a picture of a helicopter that flew over.  I carefully checked the picture I actually got of the helicopter and there is nothing else in the frame.  The "UFO picture" was a total miss of the helicopter as I tried for a 2nd shot.  I saw this white speck in that frame and enlarged it has more of an elliptical shape which drew me away from my initial assumption that it might be a balloon (it's way too early for one of the eclipse balloons).  So I decided to keep the shot and send it to you.  
It was not the moon as that came up in a different quadrant of the sky, later that evening.  It was difficult, at this distance to give many descriptors, including aura.  There was no sound but the helicopter.

summary: Single glowing object observed sometime in late afternoon.  As I recall, it was not moving.  Took a picture.  When enlarged it is rectangular in shape.
North Seattle late morning Orb pulsing different colors
description:
It was just after walking with my girlfriend to the bus stop.  She needed to go further into the city for the day, so after that I walked to the nearby store to get something to snack on, and after that I wanted to walk my dog on nearby city trial.  
I had just started the trial, I had a feeling to look up and notice what to me appear to be a ball of light getting closer.  I thought maybe it's just a plane flying by, and I was wrong, this was a pulsating Orb, it was changing colors from violet, to green and white.  So I was to capture 50 seconds of film from my iPhone 6.  Notice from the film, the Orb would disappear in some parts of the clip and negative photos show that the UFO is solid.  When the object disappeared and reappear in frame.  
I notice I was the only person on the trail.  It felt strange to witness something alone, and not to have another opinion or experience.

summary: Object made abrupt U turn at a very high rate of speed
description: On August 15th, at 3:15 AM, I had just gone to bed.  I was lying in bed by my window waiting to see if I could see a meteor.  I had a view of the southern sky.  I saw a red light approaching from the west headed east at a very high rate of speed.  The object then made a very abrupt U turn and headed back west at an even higher rate of speed.  The object came back into view and darted around the sky for approximately 30 mins.  Each time a plane would fly over the object would go away or not be visible.  When the planes had passed the object would come back.  This event lasted about 30 minutes.

summary: While laying in bed, I looked out my window and saw flashing lights flying in a way that reminded me of a plane experiencing turbulence (all bumpy and not in a straight line.).
description:
I kept watching it and the way it flew looked like a plane that was about to crash because it was such a rough flight.  It had two yellow flashing lights, and one or two red lights.
Witness provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Single intermittent flashing white light suddenly appears, traverses a small segment of the sky, then disappears.
description:
On 2 separate occasions now I have observed an unidentified flashing object in the night sky.  The first incident happened approximately 2 weeks before the date of this report, and this recent incident is what prompted me to file this report.
The description of the object is as follows:  A single white flashing light that is similar to a standard aircraft landing light in size, shape, color, and intensity.  I often see standard aircraft in the area turn on their landing lights as they enter the airspace of the Austin and Georgetown area.  Their color, as was the color of this object, is different than the light of the stars, and they appear much larger than any of the larger stars, like Vega, or planets you can see, like Jupiter.
The activity of the object is as follows:  The first incident appeared in the northwestern sky sometime after midnight around the first of August, 2017, as a white flash that I saw out of the corner of my eye, and that I initially thought was a standard aircraft.  However, when I looked in the area where I saw the light, I could see no standard aircraft marking or navigation lights, no strobes, and no shape of any aircraft.  
I diverted my attention from…

summary: Over 30 objects less then 1000 feet in altitude making no sound.
description:
My girlfriend, best friend, and I  sat and watched as over 30 low flying objects flew by in a line at less then 1000 feet.  They were less then 1 mile in distance and 1000 feet in altitude and they made no noise.  Also, in the direction they were coming from there was two lights in the sky.  One was movingly and blinking on and off, and the other was solid red, and still in the sky.  
The 30 objects all seemed to be the same, but their light patterns differed.

summary: NW part of Austin. In the West part of the sky, three lights appeared, thought it was a plane, but the lights started becoming bright and then would dim and become bright again.  Red and then white.…
description:
Aerodynamics were way to fast to be anything I've ever seen in the sky.  Movements to the left and right, up and down very rapidly made me know it wasn't just a plane.  Another one to two objects appears and they all seemed to look they they were dancing diamonds in the sky.  Tried to record, however, when I tried, the objects would disappear.  
Went back into the house to get a family member to witness as well.  Objects started right back up five minutes later then then vanished into space three minutes later.  
Glad to know I'm not crazy.

summary: Bright flashing light through the trees.  Timing it has shown it goes off every 39-41 seconds. Airplanes also heard above
description:
Standing in the driveway with my girlfriend talking and smoking a cigarette when we look up through the tree line and see a bright flash of light.  Just thinking it was lightning we ignored it, until I saw it 3 more times.  
We stayed outside for another hour until we went to get her mom.  When we told her about it and she saw it she tried to pass it off as lightning but there are no clouds in the sky.
She then told us that she saw the light when she was dropping s friend off 2 hours earlier. The light is in the same spot not moving just continuesly flashing consistently at 39-41 seconds per flash.  
We also noticed that there was an abnormal number of planes out.  We started counting and counted 6 planes in 5 minutes all in the direction of the object and one flying low directly overhead.

summary: Saw a a light start glowing bright blue then suddenly vanish.
Bright stationary pulsating light
description: For the past few days, we have witnessed a light in the sky that varied from extremely bright flashes, to very dim flashes.  It is stationary for a few minutes, and slowly begans movement, and changes direction a few times before disappearing towards the Milky Way area. Aircraft were flying in area, but those are easy to differentiate from this object..

summary: Round bright object
description:
I noticed a very bright white object to the west while I took my dogs out tonight.  The object was larger and brighter than the stars.  I watched the object for 15 minutes it didn't move like a plane and there wasn't any noise.  When it moved it at times left a streak of light behind it.  
It went from the West to the East towards I-5, which I live close to.  This object didn't move in a pattern like a plane and when it moved it took a few seconds to track where it moved to.  It was a round bright white object.  
The last time I saw it it moved toward the North East and was gone.  
The night was very clear lots of stars.  I'm not sure what this was, but I am sure it was not a plane or a star.

summary: Single white crescent shaped light soundlessly moving 80 feet above me
description:
I had gone out to the back yard with my dog and happened to look straight up.  I saw a crescent shaped light with a span of 5-6 feet, sharply defined against the dark cloudless sky approximately 80 feet above me.  It was moving from south to north in a straight line and made no sound.  Once I saw it and registered all of its detail, the light simply went out.  
I continued to watch the spot where it had been but it did not reappear. 
Once I was back inside, I wanted to check for any similar reports, but my internet was out.  Interestingly, the internet subscribers nearby were displayed and all of them had full range service.  
My internet service came on 1/2 hour later.

summary: Bright light (missile?) from the north west, descending to the south east.
description:
Solid white light very far away to the west.  It was moving much too fast to be a plane, but too slow to be a meteor.  It appeared to rise up from the horizon from the northwest, then gained altitude while heading south.  
It traveled for about 2 minutes and lost altitude, and the light went out as it was descending to the south, slightly southeast.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: 3 lights on same path dissapear individually then a giant flare upward
description: While watching sky around 8:30 pm, I witnessed about 20 degrees above the horizon 3 lights move on the same line towards the same spot like you would see satellites move, except each was alone, until disappearing, and then a giant flare upward appeared.  Once the flare went down, I noticed the second light which repeated first lights actions.  I did not see the flare on the third light.

summary: We were on our way home from work when I looked up and said “WHAT IS THAT?” .
description:
It was a bright light in the sky over the trees, a rectangular shape.  My husband looked up and said, “Did you see that?”   I was trying to keep an eye on it, when a tractor pulled out and then the trees got in the way.
By the time we came to a clearing it was gone.  
We have never seen anything like that before.

summary: White oval ufo seen near Mt. Jumbo.
description:
Walking towards the Rattlesnake Valley from the corner of E Broadway and Van Buren, myself and a friend saw what initially appeared like a helicopter, but I realized very quickly, due to the fact that you couldn't see propellers, that it couldnt be a helicopter.  
It was white, oval shape, but it also was very hazy around the object, it had a large orangey red light, and a blue light on the visible side of it.  
From our vantage point, we could see that it was well past the 'L' on Mt. Jumbo, which is just over a mile away, but as it would move towards us or away from us, or uoward, its size never changed.  We watched it for about 4 or 5 minutes, and then it simply vanished, like a switch turned it off.

summary: A large Silver rectangle shaped object in top of mountains.  seen off las vegas blvd.  Near M casino.  Tried to take pictures, but can only see a little of it.  Very reflective off the sun.  It…
UFO sighting in Milford, CT
description:
We were sitting on a bench in Silver Sand beach, when we noticed a light moving very slowly in the sky.  The light started to come closer to us and hovered about 50 feet in front of us.  I thought it was a drone, but it was too quiet and was moving very fast and erratic, with flashing white lights, in a pattern.  The craft then shot off towards Sikorsky.  
Other onlookers noticed the craft and thought it was a plane as well, but as a plane past us, you could hear the engine; this was no plane or drone.  We own a drone, and at that distance, can be heard.  
Unless it was military grade, a drone can’t fly at that great of distance; we own one.

summary: Stationary bright light
description: 08/14/17 12:20 a.m., I was driving home, east bound, and I noticed a odd haze in the sky, and then a light slowly became very bright then would dim to darkness, there seemed to be two separate lights but very close to one another.  I observed several sessions of this happening and it remained in one spot, then finally disappeared and only darkness was left as if it never happened.

summary: Small star-sized light moved across sky, then toward ground.
description: Small light, size of plane or star (about 40,000 to 50,000 feet up), moved quickly across sky, towards the east.  It made a sudden sharp right turn, then a long streak movement down towards the horizon (tree line) past Volcanoville, CA.

summary: Bright repetitive flashes during 2017 Perseid meteor showers.
description:
Following a similar sighting on the previous evening of Saturday, August 12, 2017, I accepted an invitation on Sunday, August 13, 2017, from a former pastor friend and his wife to have dinner and then go outside and watch the Perseid meteor showers before the moon rose.  After seeing a couple of very large ones, at about 10:00 PM the 3 of us witnessed a very similar repeat of the bright blue-white flash event at the same elevation and direction as I’d seen the previous night (as reported separately).  This was also followed by perhaps 6 or 7 less intense flashes at irregular intervals, but their location kept randomly shifting slightly to the left or up or down.  As the flashes became fainter, they moved slowly down and to the ESE for a considerable distance, finally becoming too faint to follow although by this time my pastor friend was tracking them with binoculars trying to see any detail (to no avail).  My friends then told me that they’d seen similar fl! ashes in the same location at about the same time the night before.
Then, at around 11:30 PM there was a reoccurrence of the flash at exactly the same position in the sky and just as brightly, followed by a couple of…

summary: Pulsing light in sky.
description:
8/13/2017 @ 9:32 p.m.
Observing the sky for Perseid meteorites and noticed a light pulse above the Angeles Crest.  I kept staring at the same spot to see if it would pulse again, and sure enough, 10 to 15 seconds later, another pulse.  
I called my son out to make sure I wasn’t imagining things and he confirmed what I was seeing.  This continued 32 times.  The light pulse was less that a second and varied in brightness each time.  It traveled from west to the east and its path spanned approximately 15 degrees within 5 minutes time then finally stopped.  
I’ve seen many satellite fly overs but nothing like this.  Can’t figure this one out???

summary: Red and Green lights moving over the sky.
description:
My husband and daughter and I were sitting in the backyard around 9:00, waiting to watch for the meteor shower, when a red light, traveling in the flight pattern (west to east), came up.  
My husband asked what it was, I thought it was a helicopter but it made no sound, and as it passed over our house, there were no blinking lights, and it appeared to be oval in shape.  
A few seconds later, another light appeared, this time green.  This repeated over a 20 minute period when another red light appeared then a white light appeared then another red.  These lights moved in the same way a helicopter would and seemed about the same distance from the ground.  Again, all lights were silent.  We saw 1 red, and 1 green light about 2 nights before this, as well.
((ADDENDUM FROM WITNESS))
Good Morning Mr. Davenport,
The time was 2100 hours.  The objects appeared to be moving from west to east with a local flight pattern.  They  seemed to be about the size of a helicopter.  There were no noticeable winds or changes as they went by and they were silent.  I will try to get further information.  They were bright like LED lights but they were not moving like balloons or anything.  They moved…

summary: I was watching Perseid meteor shower, when I noticed random flashes of light that appeared to be far off.  Then I noticed 3 small objects pulsing and moving slowly towards the moonrise.  The objects…
description:
Then in the area of the random flashes, I saw a solid orange small orb emit a beam towards one of the pulsing objects.  
I watched the small orbs moving very slowly for over an hour, until i went inside for the night.

summary: Chevron appears north of Boston
description:
Was sitting out on my back deck just before twilight watching the civilian aircraft circling in the Logan approach pattern and the high altitude military aircraft flying south over Boston.  What caught my attention was fast mover that had the afterburners kicked in moving north away from Boston at a very high rate of speed.  It is not unusual for military aircraft to be cruising in this area.  But it is unusual to see them with the afterburners kicked in with such a dense air traffic area.  
As I was watching the fast mover a single chevon shaped object momentarily appeared ahead of the interceptor and disappeared.  Had no way of gauging the distance between the interceptor and the chevron shaped object.  After the object disappeared the interceptor continued north towards New Hampshire at a slower rate of speed.

summary: Flying craft, morphed shapes, disappeared, and flew at very high speeds.
description: UFO had running lights on, very similar to what you would see on a police helicopter.  It was stationary, but very still.  I noticed it and remarked on why is a helicopter sitting like that, right there?  Then it moved, morphed shape several times, changed color of lights, disappeared all together several times, and flew at very high rate of speeds, at very low altitudes, and even though it appeared to be very close to us, it had no sound.  Shortly after it left the area, several military type aircraft circled around where it had been.  And up very high in the night sky, what looked like moving stars (not meteors) much like a commercial airliner up high in the sky, but it looked like a tiny star moving in different directions, towards where the initial UFO had gone out of sight.

summary: Hovering red light over patchogue
description: No noise red circle hovering then moved north then south quickly did the same again  Hovered again object went down quick and then back up again.  Then went south then went north then disappeared in to the east.

summary: Bright object stationary over Ohio for 90 minutes.
description:
Today is a clear sky over North East Ohio.  We are 10 miles from Lake Erie.  At an almost straight up angle, a shiny object remained stationary for 90 minutes.  
I retrieved my binoculars and we looked at it under 50 x 20 power.  The object looked like a chevron shaped object.  It only moved a slight bit.  
We had 8 people in all viewing this thing.  It appeared to be almost as high as a 36,000 ft high jet that flew near it.  When it left it just disappeared.  
No pics were taken as it was so high up.

summary: 6 ufos, one smokes and they vanish.
description:
Saw 6 hovering way up in the sky.  We decided to pull over and follow them with the car to get a video.  
One started smoking, and as we turned a corner and came to a clearing (.5 seconds later) the disks had vanished.  
All we got on camera was the smoke left in the air from the craft.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Stationary white orb/circle in sky, lnvisible during the day.
description: Several of us observed a white, round, stationary object in the sky.  It is still there after an hour.  Reports of similar objects have been reported west of us in UT.

summary: Shooting sphere
description:
Saw streak that quickly slowed down to reveal perfect sphere.  Slowing also changed colour from white orange streak to orange red sphere.  Thought it might drop from sky, but disappeared behind tree line.  
Object was low and close and travelled at improbable trajectory (perfectly horizontal)  - 45 degrees off the ground and seemingly close mile or less away.  Object was clear, outline was crisp.  
So in summary, thought I was seeing a horizontal shooting star that slowed down to reveal sphere - completely silent.

summary: Light in the sky that randomly changed color.
description: I had been driving from Minneapolis to Des Moines and had dropped a friend off West of Des Moines.  As I drove East on I-80, I saw a light that was moving in strange ways.  It was most definitely not a plane.  It was moving behind clouds then back out into plain sight.  There were no flashing lights on it, but it kept changing color seemingly randomly.  It would change between red, blue and yellow.  I pulled over to get a video with my phone but when I got out of the car, it was gone.  I had this odd feeling that it knew I was watching it… as if there was a connection between the object and me.

summary: Pinpoint jade green lights in triangular formation
description:
I was out on my balcony having a smoke before bed and noticed that the sky was very clear.  While looking up admiring the view, I noticed many faint, pinpoint jade green lights in an elongated triangular formation.  This is difficult to describe...the lights were fading in and out, it almost looked as if the tiny lights on this massive object were pulsing or something.  Every few seconds a very faint orangish yellow light would sweep across it, almost like a spotlight.  I kept rubbing my eyes because I was so boggled by this sight and just couldn't believe what I was seeing.  I tried to take pictures but my phone camera wouldn't suffice.
I went back in to my house to do a search online to see if someone might have reported this, or even better if I could find a video of it.  I went back outside to look again and it was still there.  It was stationary and this is really blowing my mind.  Many nights I've noticed the color-changing orbs flashing in random areas amongst the stars, they come and go frequently, but I've never been alarmed by them, as I am so used to seeing them. And no, they aren't stars or satellites.  This thing with the green lights was definitely a massive object…

summary: Strong light becoming a large flame, in the sky, falling down vertically towards the sea.
description: There was a strong light or even flame, falling vertically, above the sea..  Very different from a shooting star.

summary: Over the course of 15 seconds a shape appeared from nothing, became bright, and then dimmed to invisibility.
description:
I'm a 59-year old male pharmaceutical scientist, living just north of Indianapolis, Indiana.  My daughter is 20 years old and is a student at Ball State University, living at home this summer.  
On Saturday August 12 we drove about 10 miles north of our house to get away away from city lights and watch the Perseid meteor shower.  We ended up in Rosston, on East 100 North about a mile east of US 421.  It's a gravel road.  We arrived about 10:30 pm and set up chairs on the south side of the road, facing north.
Over the next 2 hours we saw about 2 dozen shooting stars.  At about 12:30 am (Sunday, August 13) I noticed a faint point of light to the north of us, about 60 degrees up from the northern horizon, traveling slowly south.  It was white and didn't blink.  I was watching it trying to think of what it might be when my daughter pointed it out to me, so she'd noticed it independently.  After watching it for another 20-30 seconds, a strange thing happened.  An image began to appear over it.  It went from invisible to brightly lit over the course of about 5 seconds, was at full brightness for about 5 seconds, and then faded back to invisibility over the course of about 5 seconds.…

summary: Red, orange sphere of light travelling North to South.  NO SOUND.  About 800 feet up.  Moving slowly.
description:
Witnessed a bright reddish orange sphere of light travelling from North to South.  NO SOUND.  About 800 feet up.  Moving slowly.
I checked the "Missing time experienced" box below because on the morning of Aug. 9th I lost 3 and half hours that I just can't account for.  I am unaware of a connection but mention it in case.

summary: I was watching the Sky from my farm around 10:00pm to about 1:00 Am and noticed the shooting stars that evening.  I counted about 37.  Some had large smoke trails on them.
description:
Then I noticed from the corner of my eye a flash of white light coming from the northwest.  I looked over and notice something strange.  I observed a glowing light.  First it would dim bright then dim back down until no lights could be seen then it would flash a bright silver white light for a few seconds then go dark.  Again, it would start to dim and glow bright then dim to darkness.  I would describe it as a pulsating light, that would flash a bright silver light after each pulse.  I observed this ship for about 30 minutes just sitting in the still darkness of  thirty acres in the middle of a forest.  It moved slowly across the night sky, until it disappeared.  
My farm is barren and has no trees.  It sits in the center of a forest with no lights or villages around for kilometers.  I started to search today about the event that took place on August 12th, 2017, at 23:30, on the internet to see if other people noticed it.  I did not find any reports so I came a cross this site to report the event.  
Thank You for this Site.

summary: Very Fast moving white chevron shape traveling north to south
description:
Eight of us are sitting around a campfire watching Peseid Meteor showers on Saturday night, August 12, 2017.  UFO appeared from the north traveling south in a straight line.  Its shape was best describes as a chevron or a flat line with tails like this [.   It covered the entire length of the night sky in about 3 seconds.  
Four of the eight exclaimed immediately, “Wow, did you see that?”  Two of the people who saw it said it zig zagged in the middle of its path and then continued on in a straight line.  The other two, myself included, did not notice any deviation from its north to south trajectory. 
There was no tail like we were seeing from the larger meteors we saw.  Its size was also much larger than any of the meteors.  There was no sound.  
The color was white with a slight blue tint.  The light we saw also appeared to pulse brighter and darker as it traveled across the sky.  
My initial thought and reaction was that we were seeing a military spy plane traveling at a high rate of speed, yet after processing it in my brain, the distance and speed it traveled far exceeded anything written about possible USA spy planes i.e. Aurora.

summary: Various intensesities of white light
description: Bright flashes seeming in a zig zag pattern each flash was of different intensities.  Also seemed to move backwards with its zig zag pattern.  There were about 7 to 8 flashes.  The flashes were of a white light in some flashes were extremely bright while others were not as intense.

summary: White flashing light moving irregularly through sky
description:
I witnessed a bright flash in the Northeastern sky, followed by a second bright flash a few seconds later.  I was watching for meteors directly above in the Milkyway, since it was a clear night.  The flash was so bright, I saw it out of the corner of my eye—a big ball of white light. It immediately grabbed my attention.  I traced the object across the sky for over 10 minutes.  It moved in an irregular pathway at an inconsistent speed, flashing at irregular intervals.  Sometimes it appeared to stay in one place for a few seconds.  Some flashes were very bright—brighter than a satellite or planet, some flashes were very faint, and many of the flashes were brighter than the stars and comparable with a planet or satellite.  All the flashes were white light and of varying durations, the longest being about half a second.  The flashing object moved in an unpredictable, zig-zag pathway across the sky, moving from the Northeast towards the West/Northwest.  After about 10 t! o 15 minutes, I lost it through the trees.
The object had to be very high in the atmosphere, if not outside the Earth’s atmosphere.  At one point, I witnessed a jet airliner fly directly under the object as it flashed,…

summary: Square Light during Perseids Meteor Shower 2017
description: Spruce Knob Lake WV, August 12, 2017 We were watching a meteor shower and witnessed a UFO. It was a square light, very very bright, and it appeared to open and close like a window or door. It moved across the sky slowly, somewhere between a very high passenger jet and a life flight helicopter. No noise was observed. It was brighter than anything else in the night sky. Weather was 50% clouds, and the meteor shower was hard to watch. This light was bright enough to see through wispy clouds. It moved across the sky and it closed, like a window or door. It would then reappear and move in a totally different direction, and it repeated this about a half dozen times. We had family members and friends in Nineveh Pa and Fairmont WV who also witnessed this light while observing the meteor shower.
